scoring_rules_extra.rule: Find underlyings from GET /api/automation/news and context.recent_news (RSS/earnings/macro). Rank catalysts that map to allowed_symbols. Do not use Reddit as the name source. Do not default to a fixed watchlist beyond SPY/QQQ for index context.
New entries need a named headline/earnings item plus tape or a fillable 1DTE chain (next session expiry). If the name has no 1DTE listing, skip.
